At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Singapore
About the Department
The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.
The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.

Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Counterpart is an Insurtech platform reimagining management and professional liability for the modern workplace. We believe that when businesses lead with clarity and confidence, they become more resilient, more innovative, and better prepared for what's ahead.

That's why we built the first Agentic Insurance™ system — where advanced AI and deep insurance expertise come together to proactively assess, mitigate, and manage risk. Backed by A rated carriers and trusted by brokers nationwide, our platform helps small businesses grow with confidence.

Join us in shaping a smarter future, helping businesses Do More With Less Risk®.
As a member of the risk engineering team, you will be responsible for the production of premium through proper risk analysis and effective distribution through our digital distribution partners. In collaboration with the Territory Managers, engineering, and operations team, you will leverage your industry knowledge and broker relationships to develop management liability and professional liability insurance products that brokers are eager to promote to their clients.

s.h: AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE YOU WILL
s.t:
Process and quote submissions accurately and on time: Work through a high volume of incoming management and professional liability submissions using Counterpart's digital platform, following established underwriting guidelines and procedures to generate timely, accurate quotes.
Learn and apply ML/PL underwriting fundamentals: Build working knowledge of policy forms, coverage terms, rating procedures, and authority parameters under the guidance of senior Risk Engineers and your team lead.
Follow up on open quotes: Actively work your quote queue. Reaching out to brokers on pending submissions, answering straightforward inquiries, and escalating non-routine or over-authority situations to the appropriate team member.
Support broker relationships: Engage with brokers in your assigned territory with responsiveness and professionalism, providing reliable service on routine submissions and helping reinforce Counterpart's reputation at every touchpoint.
Capture and relay broker feedback: Surface broker reactions, questions, and market observations to your team, contributing to the information loop that helps the team improve guidelines and the quoting experience.
Represent Counterpart in your territory: Participate in broker meetings and local industry events to build familiarity with the market and support Counterpart's visibility.
Work toward production targets: Contribute to team premium and submission goals, tracking your individual progress and flagging obstacles to your manager.
Leverage AI: Use Counterpart’s Agentic AI tools to help in your daily workflows

s.h: WE LOOK FOR TEAMMATES WHO HAVE
s.t:
1–2 years of underwriting, insurance, or related experience, with exposure to management liability, professional liability, or specialty lines preferred but not required.
Eagerness to learn ML/PL products: Curiosity about policy forms, coverage terms, and risk assessment, with a willingness to build technical knowledge quickly on the job.
Strong attention to detail and follow-through: Comfortable working through high-volume, process-driven workflows accurately and consistently.
Clear, professional communication: Able to engage brokers and internal teammates with responsiveness and care, even on routine matters.
Adaptability and coachability: Thrives in a fast-paced, tech-driven environment and responds well to feedback and direction.
College degree or equivalent experience.

Tanner Hackett, CEO : Having founded two other major startups, including Button and Lazada, Tanner now spends his time focused on mental health through his philanthropy,, in addition to reading, surfing, yoga, and enjoying the outdoors.

Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?
Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence.

SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world.

Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Reporting to the Director, Business Development, the Sr. Business Development Manager will play a key role in driving strategic partnerships and leading the commercial structuring, negotiation and execution of commercial arrangements across Studio Business Group (SBG).

SBG supports PlayStation Studios’ first-party business, working across studios and teams to enable the development and delivery of world-class gaming experiences.

Working within the broader business development strategy, this role will lead deals from initial evaluation and commercial structuring through negotiation, contracting, internal approvals and execution. The Sr.

Business Development Manager will work closely with Legal, Finance and business stakeholders to evaluate deal economics, develop commercial terms, navigate contractual and IP considerations, and drive deals toward successful completion.
The successful candidate will be an experienced and confident deal leader who combines strong commercial judgement with disciplined execution. They will be comfortable independently leading complex negotiations with external partners, while recognizing when strategic, financial or risk considerations require alignment or escalation to the Director and other senior stakeholders.
This role is located in the UK and you will operate as part of a global team, with primary responsibility for commercial matters in Europe and support for matters in other regions as business needs require.

Deal Management & Negotiation
Lead and manage commercial negotiations and strategic deals from initial opportunity assessment through execution.
Develop negotiation approaches and commercial structures aligned with established business and commercial objectives.
Evaluate deal economics, key value drivers, financial implications and trade-offs to support recommendations and decision-making.
Negotiate with external partners and identify practical solutions that balance commercial opportunity with appropriate management of risk.
Partner with senior business development and business leaders on particularly complex, high-value or strategically significant transactions.
Commercial Structuring & Contracting
Develop and negotiate commercial terms across a range of arrangements, including partnerships, licensing and other strategic commercial arrangements.
Partner closely with Legal, Finance and relevant business teams to evaluate contractual, licensing, intellectual property and financial considerations.
Translate business requirements and negotiated positions into clear commercial terms.
Identify commercial, contractual and operational risks and work with appropriate stakeholders to develop solutions or escalation paths.
End-to-End Deal Execution
Support the commercial management of agreements throughout their lifecycle, including amendments, renewals, extensions, commercial issues and exits, working with Legal and relevant business owners as appropriate.
Manage the deal process from initial evaluation and negotiation through contracting, approvals, execution and handoff.
Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders throughout the deal lifecycle to maintain alignment and drive timely decision-making.
Develop business cases, deal recommendations and materials to support internal reviews and approvals.
Maintain clear documentation of commercial positions, approvals, commitments and key decisions.
Contribute to the continued development of deal-management processes, tools and governance.
Stakeholder & Partner Management
Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and serve as a knowledgeable commercial partner throughout the deal process.
Act as a trusted commercial partner to business leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, providing advice on deal structures, commercial terms, negotiation strategy, rights and obligations, and commercial risk.
Develop and maintain trusted relationships with external partners.
Navigate differing priorities across internal teams and external partners to build alignment and move negotiations forward.
Support ongoing partner relationships and identify opportunities to strengthen or expand commercial partnerships.

8+ years of experience in business development, deal management, commercial strategy, partnerships or a related field, with a demonstrated track record of independently leading complex commercial negotiations.
A bachelor’s degree (or equivalent qualification or relevant professional experience) in Business, Law, Finance, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience structuring, negotiating and executing commercial arrangements, ideally within gaming, entertainment, media, tech or other IP-led industries.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to assess deal economics, value drivers, financial trade-offs and business implications.
Working knowledge of commercial contracts, licensing and intellectual property considerations, with experience partnering closely with Legal.
Experience managing deals across the full lifecycle, including negotiation, contracting, approvals and execution.
Strong stakeholder-management skills and experience working across complex, cross-functional organizations.
Ability to build credible and productive relationships with external partners.
Sound judgement and the ability to balance commercial opportunity with legal, financial and operational considerations.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple deals and priorities simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly communicate commercial issues, trade-offs and recommendations.
High standards of professionalism and integrity.
Some domestic and international travel will be required.

We're looking for a high-performing Senior Account Executive who thrives in complex B2B sales environments and knows how to win in fintech. IntelliDyne is a well-established government IT services firm with anchor contracts supporting DOJ and DHA. We're hiring a Business Development Manager to own and grow our pipeline across DOJ and new customer sets, with a mandate to identify, qualify, and convert opportunities that materially scale company revenue over the next 12-24 months. This is a hands-on, individually accountable role, not a strategy or thought-leadership position. You will own deals from identification through award.
What You’ll Own
You will build and maintain a qualified pipeline of DOJ and other opportunities, with “qualified” meaning you can name the incumbent, the contract vehicle, the customer’s budget posture, and a realistic path to win, not just an entry in a CRM.

You’ll support tracking the top 15 opportunities and run capture on 3-6 priority pursuits simultaneously, leading teaming decisions, price-to-win analysis, and proposal strategy in coordination with our proposal and delivery teams.

You’ll manage relationships with program offices and contracting shops at agencies including FBI, DEA, BOP, EOIR, and other program offices, and you’ll report pipeline health, win probability, and capture status to leadership on a regular cadence, with no inflated numbers and no surprises at the gate reviews.

Must have a minimum of 7-10 years in federal capture and/or business development, with direct, recent experience pursuing and winning executable work at DOJ or other agencies and not just vehicles.
Must have active and nurtured relationships with program offices, contracting officers, or industry partners at these agencies today, not relationships you used to have three jobs ago.
Must have direct experience running capture on contracts in the $25-100M+ range and can speak in specifics about win themes, teaming structures, and outcomes, including the ones lost and why.
Deep understanding of which contract vehicles (GSA MAS, SEWP, relevant IDIQs) are live, expiring, or coming up for recompete in your customer base over the next 24 months.
Thorough understanding of price-to-win analysis and aren’t just a relationship person waiting for a proposal team to do the thinking.
How We’ll Evaluate Fit
In the interview process, expect to walk through your last three captures in detail: customer budget cycle, incumbent status, your win theme, and the actual outcome. We’ll ask about your historical win rate, broken out by incumbent retention versus new business, since these are different skills and we want to know which one you’re strongest at. We’ll also ask how you personally distinguish a real opportunity from a tire-kicker, because pipeline volume without conversion doesn’t help us.

Base salary commensurate with experience, plus a significant incentive component tied to contract award value and qualified pipeline contribution — not pipeline volume alone. We're looking for someone who wants to be paid like an owner of outcomes, not a generator of activity.

This Is Not a Fit If
You're coming from a generic BD background without specific, current DOJ/DHA relationships. You think "qualified pipeline" means a long list of RFPs you've bookmarked. You're looking for a role where capture strategy is handed to you rather than built by you.

About WPP
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. A Hybrid working model
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. What does a Client Partner do at WPP Production?
As a Client Partner at WPP Production Health Studios, you are the crucial link between our dedicated pharmaceutical clients, their agency partners, and our production hubs. This is a hands-on, client-facing role where you will own the end-to-end coordination, execution, and delivery of complex, multi-channel content and production projects.
You will be the trusted day-to-day contact, ensuring meticulous planning, vigilant oversight, and timely delivery of high-quality assets that meet the rigorous standards of the pharma industry. Your ability to navigate intricate project elements, manage diverse stakeholders, and proactively solve challenges will be key to our clients' success and our continued growth.
Your mandate is to contribute to outstanding client satisfaction, ensuring successful project outcomes, fostering long-term client collaborations, and upholding WPP Production's reputation for excellence in the highly regulated pharmaceutical sector.
The Client Partner will primarily sit on-site with the team/clients in Titusville, NJ and/or Horsham, PA.   2-3 days a week onsite required.

Accountability: Own the overall project delivery for a dedicated group of clients, acting as the primary point of contact for all project-related stakeholders, including clients, agency partners and internal team.
Planning & Execution: Triage incoming work, develop sound implementation plans, and lead the execution of complex content and production projects from inception through to completion, ensuring all deliverables meet or exceed client expectations.
Orchestration: Coordinate seamlessly with our offshore production hubs (e.g., primarily in Latin America) and internal teams (e.g., Project Management, Creative, Tech) to ensure efficient workflow, clear priorities, and accurate project timelines and schedules.
Quality Assurance: Vigilantly oversee the entire production lifecycle, including creative design, development, regulatory review, and QA, to guarantee the timely delivery of high-quality, compliant omnichannel assets (digital, print, video, social, etc.).

Trusted Advisor: Serve as the main communication link with clients and their creative agency partners. This includes regularly attending client meetings and kick-offs, coordinating hand-offs, and providing proactive updates on project considerations, risks, and dependencies.
Problem Resolution: Act as a proactive problem-solver, anticipating potential issues with milestones or deliverables and swiftly identifying solutions or escalating as needed to senior management.
Partner and Champion: Work to leverage WPP Production capabilities, aligning tactical prioritization and project execution with Client’s priorities and strategic marketing goals.
Maintain fiscal integrity across all assigned projects, preparing accurate budget updates, managing financial aspects, and contributing to overall account health.

Account & Project Management: A minimum of 2-4 years of hands-on, client-facing account and/or project and delivery management experience within advertising or marketing communications.
Omnichannel Production: Proven experience managing complex digital projects and other omnichannel campaigns (digital, social, print, video, etc.) from start to finish.
Agency Background: Experience working in (preferably large) agencies on significant accounts.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated experience working effectively with multi-disciplinary teams (CX, UX, Tech, Creative, PM/AM) across remote offices, including offshore production teams.
Financial Acumen: Proven ability to manage project budgets, track fiscal responsibility, and provide accurate financial updates.
Availability to travel to the Titusville, NJ or Horsham, PA Offices on a 2-3 times a week on a hybrid schedule.

Pharmaceutical Focus (Desired): Familiarity with the complexities and regulations within pharma marketing content and its production, including an understanding of pharmaceutical review submissions, is a significant plus.
Technical Acumen: Good understanding of design, development, and production for omnichannel delivery, including web standards, user-centered design, optimization, and search practices.
Software Proficiency: Proficiency in Adobe, MS Office products and familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud).

Exceptional Communication: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex information, manage expectations, and build rapport with diverse stakeholders (clients, agencies, internal teams).
Meticulous Attention to Detail: A highly organized and detail-oriented approach, critical for managing complex production workflows and regulatory requirements.
Proactive Problem-Solver: A natural inclination to anticipate challenges, identify potential solutions, and navigate project development and production complexities with a sense of urgency and resilience.
Collaborative & Ego-less: An open, collaborative mindset, eager to contribute to a close-knit team and adapt to evolving processes and unknowns. A willingness to "wear the hats that need wearing" to ensure team success.
Optimistic & Resilient: The ability to dig in and figure out how to solve problems or identify potential solutions, knowing when to escalate issues to course correct.

The Account Manager, Annuity Strategic Accounts serves as a key relationship owner and internal quarterback for a book of assigned strategic partner firms.

Reporting into Annuity Strategic Accounts leadership, this role partners with external and internal wholesalers, firm home-office contacts, and cross-functional stakeholders to execute the partnership plan, keep the shelf and agreements current, drive campaign and promotional execution, and deliver data-driven insights that grow annuity market share within each firm.

Partner with external wholesalers, Divisional Sales Managers, and firm home-office contacts to execute the partnership plan, drive shelf placement, and grow annuity sales across Fixed, Fixed-Indexed, RILA, SPIA/DIA, and Variable Annuities.
Maintain and renew firm selling agreements, product approvals, compensation schedules, and operational requirements in coordination with Legal, Compliance, Product, and Operations.
Lead the design, launch, and post-mortem measurement of firm-level sales campaigns and promotional programs, translating results into actionable recommendations for sales leadership.
Track and report firm-level market share, production trends, rate competitiveness, and business mix; proactively flag shifts to channel leadership and Competitive Intelligence.
Own accurate, timely activity, opportunity, and account data in Salesforce so wholesalers, managers, and executives have a single source of truth on each partner firm.
Coordinate partner events, training sessions, and executive touchpoints, and represent Global Atlantic as an ambassador of the annuity product suite and value proposition.
Partner with Marketing to develop firm-approved materials, thought leadership, and communications that support field engagement and end-advisor adoption.

3+ years of experience in annuity, insurance, or investment product distribution, ideally in an account management, sales support, or channel role.
Bachelor's degree required.

Working knowledge of annuity products (Fixed, FIA, RILA, SPIA/DIA, VA) and the U.S. wealth distribution landscape (banks, wirehouses, IBDs, RIAs, IMOs).
Proficiency in Salesforce and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook); comfort turning data into insight for executive audiences.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present credibly to home-office and field partners.
Strong project management skills and the ability to run multiple firm workstreams in parallel in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
Willingness to travel up to 20% for firm meetings, conferences, and internal events.

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets.

Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets.

Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.

As a Partner Account Manager your key area of responsibility will be managing and maintaining health, support, revenue growth, and increased mindshare within an assigned list of Geotab Partners .

You will need to work closely with internal stakeholders across the company including Business Development, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Account Advisory, Marketplace, and Product .

Manage and develop Geotab Partner relationships to drive revenue and unit sales through new and existing Partners .
Enable Partner success by providing necessary tools, training, and resources to drive Geotab sales .
Work with internal stakeholders across the company (which may include team members from Business Development, Marketing, Sol utions Engineering, Account Advisory, Marketplace and Product) as needed to develop sales strateg ies and facilitate growth & expansion for assigned accounts .
Provide a feedback loop from Partners abo ut the market, customer needs, and product performance to inform product development strategy .
Document activity through Salesforce - maint ain and update regularly .
Forecast and track key account metrics including monthly, quarterly and annual forecasts - sales activations, terminations and revenue .
Ensure Partners and Geotab successfully meet agreed revenue, profitability and market share targets .
Consistently conduct regular busin ess review meetings with assigned Partners .
Manage day-to-day tasks, respond to Partners with appropriate prioritization and create urgency internally and externally when needed .
Serve as the subject matter ex pert for Part ners and their customers by keeping Partners informed abou t new products/updates, educating and demonstrating Geotab solutions (and in some channels/segments: Marketplace Partners) .
Assist with RFPs/RFIs, serve as an intermediary between Partners and Geotab’s internal RFX team as required .
Engage Partner to collaborate with the Pilots & Implementation team to facilitate prospect’s desi red outcomes, and build a deployment/onboar ding plan .

Build Geotab credibility, brand value and trust with the assigned Partner network .
Coach and develop the assi gned Partner network on Geotab solutions via in-person meetings, platform training, product demonstrations, webinars and participation in their customer calls and appointments .
Regularly consult with marketing to maximize success of co-marketing and lead generation activities and initiatives, and to ensure that the Geotab brand is best posi tioned in each Partner's portfolio .
Liaise with internal teams to share knowledge, insight and understanding from Partner networks about Partner and end customer satisfaction .
Attend trade shows and conferenc es to build company credibility, brand presence and identify new Partner expansion opportunities .
Maintain current knowledge of all Geotab solutions, technology platforms, competitors and industry trends that impact the Partner network .

Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.
